reason: DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.getTokenContextFromTokenId throws unless the prefix is exactly 6 characters and splits it 2+2+2 (DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider.java patch lines 309-316). The new OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut javadoc says shortcuts are usually about 3 letters, and nothing checks their length when they are registered (Factory postInit / getShortcutByGrantType). So a 3-letter custom shortcut encodes to a 7-character prefix that decoding then rejects.
